title: Amazon Prime US members (millions)
notes: CIRP counts everyone in a household with access to a Prime membership, not just the paying subscriber. 2015 figure (54 million) reported by NBC News; 2024 figure (180 million, as of March 2024) reported by Bloomberg/Yahoo Finance covering the same CIRP tracking series (https://finance.yahoo.com/news/amazon-prime-memberships-us-gain-175715711.html).
